docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
My background is in Geology and Geophysics. I specialised in geospatial data analysis and visualisation. I spent 15 years managing, processing and interpretating mineral exploration data. Now, I am working on automating workflow of predictive mineral resource targeting based on remote sensing imagery and GIS to drastically reduce the cost of prospection. I am mainly using Colab, Google Earth Engine and QGIS (of course!). Besides that, I am developing GGG (Golden Geo GIS) to associate my passion for remote database administration.
